info.name: GreenLove Farms
info.description:
Auth, catalog, carts and checkout stacks.

Run Auth → Login first; it stores idToken, which signed-in requests send as a Bearer token. Catalog → Admin uses adminIdToken from Auth → Admin login.

Automated run: postman/run-tests.sh (Newman), or the Collection Runner with automated=true. Requests run in order and pass ids along; "Manual" requests are skipped.

Generated by postman/build-collection.mjs — edit that file, not this collection, or changes will be overwritten on the next push.

request.description: Saves idToken (sent as the Bearer token), accessToken, refreshToken and expiresIn.
Every field is optional; only the fields sent are changed.
Default first. Each address has an id for editing.

exec: pm.test('one default, with ids', () => { pm.expect(r.items.filter((a) => a.isDefault)).to.have.lengthOf(1); r.items.forEach((a) => pm.expect(a.id).to.be.a('string')); });

request.description: Partial: only the fields sent change.

exec: pm.test('edited, rest kept', () => { pm.expect(a.line2).to.eql('Suite 200'); pm.expect(a.line1).to.eql('500 Main St'); });

pm.test('first is default, work is not', () => { pm.expect(r.items[0].id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('homeAddressId')); pm.expect(r.items.find((a) => a.id === pm.environment.get('addressId')).isDefault).to.be.false; });

request.description: A Staff or Admins user. Saves adminIdToken, used by Catalog → Admin.

item.name: Manual (email codes)

request.description: Use the code emailed by Cognito.
Admins only. role: CUSTOMER | STAFF | ADMIN. Takes effect on the target user's next sign-in or refresh.

item.description: Skipped in automated runs: these send emails, need a code from an inbox, or change real roles.

item.description: Requires a Staff or Admins user — run Auth → Admin login first.

exec: // Without the admin-created test product, fall back to a live product with stock for the cart and checkout tests.
const live = r.items.map((p) => ({ p, v: p.variants.find((v) => v.available === null || v.available > 2) })).find((x) => x.v);

query.description: featured (default) | newest | price_asc | price_desc | relevance (needs q)

exec: pm.test('sorted by price', () => { const p = r.items.map((i) => i.priceFromCents); pm.expect(p).to.eql([...p].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });

query.description: Atlas Search: name, synonyms (searchTerms) and descriptions; forgives one typo

exec: if (pm.environment.get('testCategoryCreated')) pm.test('test category counts its product', () => { const c = r.items.find((i) => i.slug === 'postman-test'); pm.expect(c && c.productCount).to.be.at.least(pm.environment.get('testProductCreated') ? 1 : 0); });

request.description: Call after login to fold the browser's anonymous cart into the account cart.

exec: if (pm.environment.get('productId')) pm.test('merged line present', () => pm.expect(c.lines.some((l) => l.variantId === pm.environment.get('variantId'))).to.be.true);

request.description: The anonymous cart's views move to the account when it merges.
A merged cart is no longer usable anonymously.
Call on every checkout change. Problems come back as issues with HTTP 200.

exec: pm.test('asks for a method and contact', () => pm.expect(q.issues.map((i) => i.code)).to.include.members(['METHOD_REQUIRED', 'CONTACT_REQUIRED']));
pm.test('total = subtotal + fees + tax', () => { const t = q.totals; pm.expect(t.totalCents).to.eql(t.subtotalCents - t.discountCents + t.deliveryCents + t.shippingCents + t.taxCents); });

request.description: Holds the stock and returns the PaymentIntent client secret for stripe.confirmPayment().
Stripe test card pm_card_chargeDeclined. Sandbox only.
Stripe test card pm_card_visa. Sandbox only.
The confirmation page polls this until the webhook has created the order.
The paid cart is closed, so the guest cart is no longer found.
Contact comes from the account (email is always the verified account email).

exec: pm.test('total = subtotal + fees + tax', () => { const t = q.totals; pm.expect(t.totalCents).to.eql(t.subtotalCents - t.discountCents + t.deliveryCents + t.shippingCents + t.taxCents); });
